The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]' '''second''' of three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], located in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]], was a barren [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] of rocky canyons and scrubs.<ref name="pg">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The moon formerly served as a training ground and ordnance testing zone for the [[Bothan Militia]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The subsequent craters and other features (caused by thousands of test [[proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]]), were used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and played host to the [[Kothlis shadowport]].<ref name="pg" />
